body.message:
Please note that the rates for all guest extensions have been adjusted due to the current market conditions; this is not specific to your booking.

You still have time to confirm your extension, and we kindly note that we are unable to offer the same rate as your previous booking.

Our rates are dynamic and subject to change based on market conditions. If the payment had been made at the time we provided the previous rate, we would have been able to honor that rate. However, as the payment was not made at that time, the rate has now changed.

Thank you for your understanding.
